test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select an option that has the pair of letter clusters with same relation between the letter clusters as is seen in the following pair:

AFKP : ZUPK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:

AFKP : ZUPK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11933adde69fc37d07adb20192bf2cc02e879d91cfc206919f50e13eabe253b0.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) EJOT : VWXY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5239f1af405c31066631500dc2b3efdb5d8243d79b7dd361896b87238fd5c07.png] 

Option 2) BGLQ : YTOJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9921f4574b80cf191615f0536a6df9d3999e0bc35558c2a665f320a3c3972cb.png] 

Option 3) CHMR : WRMH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/664b22a2d6f80f6ab98967189bba114b5cc7fb4c8a9f5a5da3db1fbad4f377c5.png] 

Option 4) DINS : XSNI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5148a6b8e64889081d16c6c10344eb56d5ae8476f114ada72973a42efe1ca932.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'BGLQ : YTOJ' follows the same pattern as given.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
